name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students
overview: A scholarship scheme providing financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet a part of their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies.
objectives: Provide financial assistance to meritorious students from economically weaker sections
Recognise merit at Class XII level

benefits.title: Scholarship Amount
benefits.description: Fixed monthly/annual scholarship amount for graduation and post-graduation, disbursed via DBT

education: Class XII pass with high percentile marks
otherCriteria: Pursuing regular degree courses in recognised institutions

applicationProcess.description: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)

faqs.question: Who is eligible?
faqs.answer: Students who cleared Class XII within the top percentile and have family income within the prescribed limit.

faqs.question: How is the scholarship renewed?
faqs.answer: Based on maintaining minimum required academic performance each year.

name: PM Vidyalaxmi Scheme
overview: A scheme to provide collateral-free education loans to meritorious students admitted to quality higher education institutions, along with interest subvention for economically weaker students.
objectives: Ensure no student is denied higher education due to financial constraints
Provide collateral-free education loans to meritorious students
Offer interest subvention for economically weaker sections

benefits.title: Collateral-free Loan
benefits.description: Education loans without collateral or third-party guarantee up to a specified limit

benefits.title: Interest Subvention
benefits.description: Interest subsidy for students from economically weaker families

education: Admission to a Quality Higher Education Institution
otherCriteria: Indian citizens admitted to recognised quality higher education institutions

applicationProcess.description: Apply through the PM Vidyalaxmi portal
Select empanelled bank for the loan
Loan sanctioned and disbursed to the institution

faqs.question: Is collateral required?
faqs.answer: No, for loans up to the specified threshold under the scheme.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for interest subvention?
faqs.answer: Students from families with annual income up to the prescribed limit.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students

ministry.name: Ministry of Education
ministry.department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)

overview: A scholarship scheme to provide financial assistance to girl students pursuing technical education in AICTE-approved institutions, to encourage their participation in technical courses.
objectives: Encourage girl students to pursue technical education
Reduce financial barriers for female students in AICTE-approved institutions
Improve gender diversity in technical education

benefits.title: Scholarship Amount
benefits.description: Annual scholarship covering tuition fee reimbursement and incidental allowance

education: Admission in first year of a technical degree/diploma course in an AICTE-approved institution
otherCriteria: Maximum two girl children per family are eligible

applicationProcess.description: Register on the AICTE Pragati portal
Fill application with academic and family details

faqs.question: How many students are selected?
faqs.answer: A fixed number of slots per technical institution as notified by AICTE each year.

faqs.question: Is this only for engineering students?
faqs.answer: It covers various AICTE-approved technical diploma and degree programmes.

name: Top Class Education Scheme for Scheduled Caste Students

ministry.name: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
ministry.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment

overview: A scheme providing full financial support to meritorious Scheduled Caste students for pursuing notified higher education courses in top-ranked institutions.
objectives: Enable SC students to pursue quality higher education in premier institutions
Cover full cost of tuition and maintenance for selected students
Encourage merit among SC students in higher studies

benefits.title: Full Financial Support
benefits.description: Complete coverage of tuition fees, living and other allowances at notified institutions

education: Admission to notified premier institutions for specified courses

applicationProcess.description: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal
Selection based on merit and income criteria

faqs.question: Which institutions are covered?
faqs.answer: A notified list of top-ranked institutes across disciplines.

faqs.question: What is the income ceiling?
faqs.answer: As prescribed under the scheme guidelines, subject to periodic revision.

name: National Fellowship for Other Backward Classes (OBC) Students

ministry.name: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
ministry.department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment

overview: A fellowship scheme providing financial support to OBC students pursuing M.Phil and Ph.D. degrees in sciences, humanities and social sciences from recognised universities and institutions.
objectives: Promote higher research education among OBC students
Provide financial assistance during M.Phil/Ph.D. studies
Improve representation of OBC candidates in research

benefits.title: Fellowship Amount
benefits.description: Monthly fellowship and contingency allowance during the research period

education: Enrolled in M.Phil/Ph.D. programme in a recognised university

applicationProcess.description: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal during notified window
Selection based on UGC-NET or equivalent qualifying criteria

faqs.question: What is the fellowship duration?
faqs.answer: Up to a maximum period as prescribed for M.Phil and Ph.D. respectively.

faqs.question: Is non-creamy layer certificate mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, an OBC non-creamy layer certificate is required.
